# Sarwar Shuvo — Digital Marketing Manager

> Portfolio of Sarwar Shuvo, a Digital Marketing Manager based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working with businesses across Bangladesh, the Middle East, and Europe. Focus on outcome-driven marketing: qualified leads, customers, and revenue rather than vanity metrics.

## About
Sarwar Shuvo helps businesses turn marketing into measurable growth using Meta Ads, Google Ads, AI automation, SEO, and performance marketing. Approach: understand the business, follow the data, cut what is not working, and scale what is.
